sloka: प्रतिजाने च ते वीर मा भूवम् वीर लोक भाक् ।राज्यम् च तव रक्षेयम् अहम् वेला इव सागरम् ॥२-२३-२८॥
transliteration: pratijāne ca te vīra mā bhūvam vīra loka bhāk ।rājyam ca tava rakṣeyam aham velā iva sāgaram ॥2-23-28॥

translations.english: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the ocean. Or else, I shall never attain the afterworld of heroes.
